title: A non-holder note should not move the session's focus
outcome: A non-holder note should not move the session's focus
acceptance: A note by a session that does not hold the item leaves that session's focus unchanged; a holder's note still moves focus
A test shows a non-holder note followed by a source-changing turn attributes the change to the session's previous focus, not to the noted item

completion.summary: note, gate and evaluate naming an item this session does not hold now leave its focus where it was. They resolve the target through resolve_target and target_unfocused, and move focus only through focus_if_held when this session holds a live claim. A holder's note still moves focus. Tests in src/work_service/update/tests/observations.rs cover this, and a source-changing turn after a non-holder note is attributed to the previous focus. The MCP dogfood test drops the re-claim after an explicit observation. Landed as 24634aa (pushed) and installed as build 7094b7cc6743. Independent evaluation passed both criteria.
